::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 8th [1887]  
**From:** Clovelly Belgrave Crescent Torquay  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)

I wrote the paper you asked me to do for the [CQ](organizations/other_60.qmd) but I am sorry to say it was not good enough, and was rejected. I rather suspected that it would be for it was too long and too like a report. Do you like to have it for use in any other way?  I have had an article from Mr Donald Mackay sent me for the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) for August on the Centenary[^1]

I shall come home on the 16th, and I will then send your books back with many thanks, and wishes I had done it better

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: D.J. Mackey, ‘The Centenary of the Colonial Church’ *MP* (August 1887) 187-92.
